exposure: Gut colonization with ESBL-producing Escherichia coli (ESBL-PEco)
Gut colonization with ESBL-producing Klebsiella pneumoniae (ESBL-PKpn)
cohort: Neonatal patients admitted to a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) of the Hospital Infantil de Mexico Federico Gomez.
finding: High rates of gut colonization by ESBL-PEco and ESBL-PKpn were observed in neonates, with 22% of colonized patients developing HAIs, and significant risk factors for these infections included longer hospital stay, duration of antibiotic treatment, and invasive device usage.
followup_time: Until discharge from the neonatology ward (variable per patient)
